items.headline: Marvell Technology stock surges on wave of bullish analyst commentary tied to accelerating AI infrastructure demand and custom silicon wins
Wall Street firms hike Marvell Technology price targets (Wells Fargo to $195, RBC and Oppenheimer to $200) on stronger AI networking and custom chip demand
Speculation about Marvell collaboration with Google on custom AI designs and memory chips for TPUs boosts optimism about AI silicon opportunity beyond networking
Commentary highlights Marvell benefiting from accelerating AI infrastructure spending in hyperscale data centers and optical interconnects, supporting expectations for continued revenue growth
Opinion: Recent Marvell sell-off seen as overreaction; analysts argue AI story remains intact with long‑term bullish outlook focused on data centers and cloud
Marvell Technology nears new 52‑week high; options market implies ~13% swing around upcoming earnings
